checks.name: every set tapped gives an immediate visual response (button busy within 100 ms) in all online scenarios
normal / latency / slow-write scenarios persist the set once in BOTH documents and confirm only after both writes resolved
CDP 300 ms network latency: never confirmed before persisted; ends persisted once in both documents (state at the tap is reported in the summary, not asserted)
double tap: exactly one mesos write and one root write, key persisted once
root write failure: NEVER confirmed (no "✓ GUARDADO"), error shown, button usable again, nothing persisted in the root document
mesos-only failure stays non-fatal by design: the set is confirmed and the root document holds it
offline: never claims a confirmed save ("✓ GUARDADO"), shows pending/local state, and after reconnection persists the set once in both documents
invalid input (empty load) is rejected before any write and the button comes back usable with its original label
root write failure restores the original button label (not "GUARDANDO…")

notes: Emulator + injected delay; not production or network latency.
